MEASURED 2026-09-20: navhard has no entry in model_arms.DEFAULT_BANKS, so `frame_bank` was written as null, and W5's `Path(run.scenes.get('frame_bank', ''))` raised TypeError: Path(None) -- taking down the WHOLE report of a COMPLETE run whose scores were fine. Warmup was unaffected only because it HAS a default bank, which is why this survived every warmup run.
